steps.path: Two skills back to back, a deliverable, then a skill in the next turn
steps.headline: Two skills invoked back to back at the start of a turn no longer leave a hollow bubble above the reply.
steps.changed: Same fix as the single-skill case: the sliver that held nothing is skipped. The skill cards still sit at the end of the turn, after the deliverables card.
steps.notice: The reply starts one sliver higher. Both skill cards and the file card are where they were, and the next turn's skill is unaffected.

steps.path: Files sent at three points in one turn (native model with reasoning)
steps.headline: Files sent mid-turn no longer leave small empty bubbles after each Deliverables card.
steps.changed: The model sent a blank chunk after each file card; each blank used to become an empty bubble. Those are ignored now.
steps.notice: Three bubbles, one per step: report, then the regenerated charts with their tool, then the summary. The two Deliverables cards keep their captions.
steps.risk: The file tiles show generic icons here because the screenshot tool has no real files to thumbnail; the app shows previews.

steps.path: One turn with reasoning, a skill, tools, an edit and a deliverable, then a cut-off turn
steps.headline: A busy turn reads as three steps with grouped tools, and a cut-off reply keeps its note at the bottom.
steps.changed: The two tools the model called in its first step share a group (“2 tools — all complete”) instead of splitting across bubbles. The truncated turn's note is unchanged.
steps.measured: Before: 4 bubbles for the first two steps; after: 2
steps.notice: Grouped tools read as one line until expanded. The skill card lands at the very end of the turn, after the file card. The second turn ends with “Response truncated”.
steps.risk: Before and after are scrolled differently because the before version is taller; compare the bubble count, not the position.

steps.path: Skills invoked at different points in one turn
steps.headline: Where should a skill card sit when the skill was invoked partway through a turn?

options.label: Keep it: all skill cards at the end of the turn
options.summary: Today's behaviour, shown in the picture. Brainstorming was invoked before the questions and writing-plans before the plan, but both cards sit under the last bubble.
options.cost: No change. You cannot tell from the cards when each skill was used.

options.label: Each skill card stays in the bubble where it was invoked
options.summary: The brainstorming card would sit under “Starting with the design pass.” and the writing-plans card under “…Writing the plan now.” Cards still render below that bubble's tools.
options.cost: A small change to the chat view. A turn that opens with a skill and nothing else would show the card in a bubble of its own.

options.label: Skill cards at the end, but one line each
options.summary: Keep them at the end and shrink each to a single compact line so several skills cost less height.
options.cost: A new compact card size to design and review.
